shellRuntime.f1400: Jiao (角宿) is the horn of the Azure Dragon of the East, the very first of the twenty-seven mansions. The eight characters themselves never change for a lifetime, but ten-year major cycles and one-year annual cycles pass over them, so even for the same person the theme in the foreground shifts with the period. This is not a way of sorting good charts from bad ones. Seeing which force is currently excessive and what is missing — and setting a direction to make up for it — is what actually proves useful. The calculation that builds the chart and the reading of the five-element and ten-god placements are automated, and AI interpretation is used to turn the result into sentences, so the same chart is read differently to suit the period and the question.
